items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: my maternal grandmother was Anna French.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

my maternal grandmother was Anna French. My mother's name was Gertrude and my father's name was Frank. But my father died when I was 3 years old and I lived mainly with my mother's family although we all lived in Homestead within a distance of about five blocks apart at any given moment.
Yeah. You were telling me last time or the time before about one set of your grandparents being theater proprietors in south-east Pennsylvania.
